analysis.title: DeskTalk - Election night repricing underway
key_insights: Democrats are on track for a larger-than-expected Senate majority, and DDHQ has projected that Democrats regain control of the House.
Markets are reacting sharply to the prospect of a larger-than-expected Democratic victory. Nasdaq-100 futures are down nearly 2%, Kospi is down 3% and Nikkei is down 4%.

The selloff is driven largely by concerns about the future of the AI data center build-out. Prediction markets give Gina Hinojosa (D) a 94% chance to defeat incumbent Greg Abbott (R) in the Texas gubernatorial race.
Roughly 125 Democratic campaigns across House, Senate and gubernatorial races ran on data center energy usage.
Citi strategist Scott Chronert sees the possibility that markets price in the risk of higher corporate taxes after 2028, based on tonight's results.
Treasuries are bid on the risk-off move. Yields are lower across the curve and the 10-year yield fell more than 7bps to break below 4.90%.
The DXY is down 0.4% to its weakest level in a month. Citi's G10 FX Strategy team continues to favor fading USD weakness ahead of upcoming US data and possible further escalation in the Middle East.
USDJPY is down 0.70%. Citi's eFX desk sees JPY inflows from leveraged accounts so far.
Near-term focus is on the remaining election results and Wednesday's potentially dovish Quarterly Refunding Announcement.

sector_views.rationale: Nasdaq-100 futures are down nearly 2% on concern that Democratic wins, including a likely flip of the Texas governorship, threaten the AI data center build-out.

macro_indicators.interpretation: Yields fell across the curve as investors sought safety during the election-night risk-off move.
The dollar is falling alongside lower US yields. Citi's G10 FX team favors fading the USD weakness.
A dovish refunding announcement is a near-term focus for rates and the dollar.

trade_ideas.rationale: Citi's G10 FX Strategy team favors fading USD weakness ahead of upcoming US data and the potential for further escalation in the Middle East.

risk_factors: Concern over the future of the AI data center build-out if Democratic wins, including in Texas, lead to restrictions tied to energy usage.
Markets may price in the risk of higher corporate taxes after 2028.
Possible further escalation in the Middle East.
